facts.fact: Rema has been a clerk for thirty years.
Rema carried the second case five days from Kodiyur.
The queen's writ names Captain Muthu by office as holder of the pass seal in trust.
Rema offers to record Neela's departure by sunset as proof the warden harboured no unvouched odiyan.
Devan offers Rema the green-sealed last quire in the south range; Rema refuses to break the queen's seal or carry it to a high court that may not sit, and hands it back. Devan keeps it in his pack.
